executiveSummary: Threat activity against OT-adjacent edge appliances, identity and email systems, and even PLCs remains elevated. Multiple government alerts confirm active exploitation and pre-positioning in critical sectors, alongside mass exploitation of widely deployed network gear and VPNs. Notable risks this period include: (1) active reconnaissance and capability development targeting Siemens S7 PLCs across water, energy, chemical, and manufacturing sectors Security Advisory ; (2) attacks on industrial refrigeration and cold-chain controllers resulting in real operational losses and public-health risks Supporting Report View Article ; (3) unauthenticated exploitation paths against NetScaler ADC/Gateway at the enterprise perimeter Security Advisory ; (4) an OpenSSH password-authentication bypass in musl-based Linux (notably Alpine) observed exploited within hours View Article ; and (5) mass exploitation of Zyxel GS1900 access switches enabling unauthenticated root command execution and configuration theft View Article . Nation-state posture remains a concern at the edge: U.S. and allied advisories warn of Russian FSB Center 16 campaigns abusing router misconfigurations and legacy services to exfiltrate configs and pivot inward Security Advisory , while China-nexus groups increasingly operate via covert networks of compromised SOHO/IoT devices to mask origins and pre-position in critical infrastructure Security Advisory . Concurrently, #StopRansomware guidance highlights affiliates actively exploiting internet-facing VPN/firewall devices, with Fortinet paths favored by Gunra, to drive destructive business outages that can cascade into OT when segmentation is weak Security Advisory . Enterprise IT systems that often bridge to operations also saw aggressive targeting: a Zimbra webmail zero-day used by Russian state-linked actors to exfiltrate mailboxes and persist via app passwords Security Advisory ; mass exploitation of Oracle PeopleSoft (CVE-2026-35273) impacting government and aviation supply chains with WAF-bypass techniques View Article View Article ; and KEV-listed flaws in GitLab and Cisco ASA/FTD confirming active exploitation of key perimeter and DevOps platforms Security Advisory . Given the confluence of OT-relevant advisories, active exploitation at the edge, and rapid weaponization of new issues, we assess the OT/ICS threat level as HIGH for the next 1-2 weeks. Focus remediation on exposed edge appliances, remote-access paths, and identity/email systems with direct conduits to operations.

relevance: Operational risk this period is driven by (a) direct PLC targeting and cold-chain controller attacks with process impacts; (b) exploitation of enterprise edge appliances (NetScaler, ASA/FTD, Zyxel switches, OpenSSH on Alpine) that commonly sit on or guard conduits into OT; and (c) identity/email compromises (Zimbra) and HR/ERP exposure (PeopleSoft) that enable persistent access and lateral movement toward operations. Nation-state advisories emphasize stealthy ingress via routers and covert SOHO/IoT networks. For asset owners, the risk pattern remains initial foothold in IT via exposed or misconfigured edge → credential theft and LOTL movement → targeting of high-value management planes and OT adjacencies.

descriptions: T1090 Proxy/Multiple Hops: Covert SOHO/IoT networks; residential proxy SDKs on enterprise/government devices.
T1133 External Remote Services: Exploitation of VPN/firewall appliances; OpenSSH auth bypass on Alpine.
T1190 Exploit Public-Facing Application: NetScaler ADC/Gateway, Zimbra, Oracle PeopleSoft, PHP RCE, EV charger OCPP.
T1041 Exfiltration Over C2 Channel / T1048 Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol: Zimbra webmail exfil via SOAP/DNS/HTTPS; router TFTP config copies.
T1003 Credential Dumping / T1555 Credentials from Password Stores: Router/SNMP config theft; Zimbra IMAP app passwords; PeopleSoft session abuse.
T1105 Ingress Tool Transfer / T1059 Command and Scripting Interpreter: LOTL PowerShell/WMI/Impacket; PLC S7comm PUT/GET scripting (snap7).

outlook72h: Edge Hotfix Sprint: NetScaler, ASA/FTD, OpenSSH (musl/Alpine), Zyxel GS1900-patch/mitigate; remove any public admin exposure; enforce MFA. OT Exposure Sweep: Identify and immediately remove Internet-facing refrigeration controllers, EV chargers (OCPP), OPC UA endpoints, and PLC web servers. Email & HR Footholds: Patch Zimbra and PeopleSoft; revoke app passwords/tokens; enable DLP for mailbox/HR data exports; update WAF normalization for encoding evasions. Router Hygiene: Disable SNMPv1/v2, TFTP, Cisco Smart Install; rotate creds; baseline SNMP; block UDP/69 and TCP/4786 at edges. PLC Hardening & Monitoring: Enforce engineering workstation allowlists; deploy ICS IDS rules for S7comm; validate backups and code-signing where supported. Execution Tip: Treat KEV-listed items as time-boxed tasks with verification for pre-patch compromise. Stage changes through an OT maintenance window with defined rollback.
